title: Quarterly Stitch: Cohort Phasing, Canary Windows, and Rapid Triage for Hosted Model Catalog
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: Define a repeatable quarterly play for phasing model cohort rollouts across Hosted API lanes that balances latency SLOs, cost hedges, and quality guardrails. Outcome should be a prescriptive runbook that maps cohorts -> canary windows -> rollback triggers -> capacity hedges and clear owner assignments. This ticket consolidates PM decisions, cross-team signoffs, and runbook artifacts for Q3 model onboarding and rotation.
acceptance_criteria: Documented cohort definitions (A/B/C) tied to traffic, SLA tier, and customer cohorts
Canary schedule template with explicit duration, traffic ramp, and automated metrics checks
Rollback and fallback matrix coupling model variants + capacity tier (hosted, dedicated, fallback model)
Operational checklist integrated into Console (alerts, dashboards, token-level cost checks)
Stakeholder signoff from Runtime, Console, and Reliability teams
Dry-run simulation for one medium-risk model showing expected latency and cost delta
milestones: 2026-03-18: Draft cohort taxonomy and phasing matrix (PM leads)
2026-03-25: Align with ENG on canary automation feasibility and metrics (incident response, latency p95, token cost)
2026-04-08: Publish runbook draft and integrate basic checks into Console staging dashboards
2026-04-22: Cross-team tabletop dry-run and update rollback thresholds
2026-05-06: Final signoff and schedule first cohort rollout for early-June window
risks: Underestimated cold-start and KV cache effects across cohorts leading to p95 regressions
Capacity contention with other Hosted API launches in the same window
Incomplete observability for per-route token-level cost could hide regressions
Security review delays for models with customer-provided weights (Private/Dedicated boundary)
mitigations: Lock a small dedicated capacity hedge for initial canaries and instrument KV cache warmers
Coordinate with Capacity Ops to reserve burst nodes during canary windows
Add token-cost smoke checks to per-route dashboard and gate canary progression on cost anomaly detection
Start security review in parallel and create a templated checklist for model onboarding
communication_plan: Weekly digest to product-eng-all + targeted pre-canary emails to CS and select customers; post-mortem template ready to publish in Drive; Slack channel #pm-model-cohorts for real-time coordination.
